headline: Casey’s Invites Guests to Support Local Schools and Students through Annual Cash for Classrooms Campaign
summary: ANKENY, Iowa, July 30, 2026--Guests in Casey's communities are invited to support local K-12 public and nonprofit private schools through the annual Cash for Classrooms campaign starting today. With the support of The Coca-Cola Company, Casey's aims to raise $1.4 million to support grants that fund physical improvements, classroom resources, teacher support and community engagement.
